main_text.p: nim hic quicquam è trivio desumptum est, aut à vulgari ratione disputandi ; ve-rum id ipsum, quod ex abditis juris regulis quę in rebus agendis obtinent , [?]etitum est penetralibus. Et licet bene multi, sparsim nonnulla huc facientia, sun[?]t scriptis inseruerint, quę equidem, vidi, & legi, nec contempsi; nulli tamen, quod sciam, universam illam de Jure statutario materiam, (minime illam ipsam partem, de quâ maximè laborandum erat), aut pertractarunt. aut ordine sunt complexi. Multo minus regulas exhibuerunt, quibus veluti thesibus premissis, multis hypothesibus, jure consuetudinario, atquė statutario firmatis, sua constaret ratio. Quod an meo libello confecero, non equidem velim affirmare; ut qui non ignorem alia multa hactenus à me traditis, superaddi posse. Sperarę tamen ausim, mē viris solidâ juris civilis scientiâ imbutis, inque praxi hodierna satis exercitatis, viam monstrasse, quam forte planam suâ industriâ planissimam, ac tutissimam sunt redditur[?]. Huic meo instituto si faveris lector judiciosè, me forte ad plura & majora proferenda in publicum instigabis.

page.notes: The first word "nim" is a fragment of "nimirum" or similar, continuing from the previous page. The word after "obtinent" is unclear, probably a word beginning with a long s or P, shown as [?]. "sun[?]t" is a doubtful reading of the word before "scriptis". The final word "redditur[?]" is printed as "reddituri" with a damaged ending. Some words are blurred by show-through and stains; readings were checked against the scan, and the "planam suâ industriâ planissimam" order follows the print.
